output_semantics_to_verify: Check deployed server reasoning, special-token and stop-token accounting; do not assume visible-text retokenization.
success_rule: HTTP 200, normal SSE DONE, stop/length finish, final usage, supported payload consistent with count
failure_rule: Partial outputs from failed requests do not contribute effective tokens; failure time remains in full run window.
zero_output_rule: A completed stop/length response with actual usage zero and no payload can succeed but has no TTFT sample.
window: Before worker launch to completion and collection of all selected requests, excluding prior DNS resolution and separate warmup.
ttft: Actual HTTP call start to first nonempty content or reasoning SSE event, successful requests only.
e2e: Actual HTTP call start to terminal state, successful requests only.
arrival_lag: Saved separately; not included in TTFT/E2E. Extend metrics if SLO begins at scheduled arrival.
client_policy: Record and match actual client_measurement_policy_sha256 within each scenario's comparison.
warmup: Task-specific separate workload outside scoring window; verify readiness and drain before scoring.
quality_and_slo: Declare task-specific quality scope and all comparison guards before formal trials. This example does not establish them.
